biocs.name: PowerShell with Rare GitHub URL
biocs.description: PowerShell process executing command that downloads from a rare GitHub URL
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'raw.githubusercontent.com'

abiocs.name: Rare GitHub URL Execution
abiocs.description: Execution of a process downloading from a rare GitHub URL
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_command_line contains 'raw.githubusercontent.com'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
